aboutProblemTimeBlackHoleDesc.message: Originally intended to entertain for a while, but ended up scrolling social media for hours

aboutProblemAttentionScatteredDesc.message: Can't help but click on Weibo, Bilibili, YouTube, unable to focus on important tasks

aboutProblemMentalFrictionDesc.message: Unconsciously scrolling feeds to kill time when bored, but feeling more empty and confused afterwards

aboutProblemGoalDeviationDesc.message: Intended to study or solve problems, but got distracted by recommended content, only to realize an hour later that you completely forgot what you originally wanted to do

aboutStatRefocusTime.message: Time required to refocus after each interruption

aboutStatRefocusTimeSource.message: Research by Professor Gloria Mark, UC Irvine

aboutStatSocialMediaTime.message: Global daily average social media usage

aboutFeatureFocusFunModeDesc.message: Focus mode: Block recommended content and distracting elements on social media with one click; Fun mode: Open information flow

aboutFeatureTimeManagementDesc.message: Set time limits for each website, automatically block information flow when the limit is reached, helping you build healthy internet habits

aboutFeatureUsageStatsDesc.message: Record your internet time and habits in detail, so you can clearly understand where your time is spent

aboutFeatureDelayedEffectDesc.message: Prevent impulsive removal of restrictions - removing website restrictions or increasing time requires next day to take effect, giving you time to think calmly

aboutFeatureSelfRestraintDesc.message: Once restrictions are set, they cannot be easily modified, helping you overcome weak willpower

aboutFeatureCustomRulesDesc.message: Flexibly set access rules for different websites, allowing you to focus at work and relax during breaks

aboutBenefitProductivityDesc.message: Reduce distractions, allowing you to focus on important tasks for long periods, significantly improving work quality and speed

aboutBenefitMentalHealthDesc.message: Reduce meaningless information intake, lower anxiety, and give your brain real rest

aboutBenefitSelfControlDesc.message: With tool assistance, gradually develop good digital habits and improve self-management abilities

aboutBenefitTimeSovereigntyDesc.message: No longer be led by algorithm recommendations, you decide how to allocate your time and attention

aboutStepPinExtensionDesc.message: Pin FeedSwitch to the toolbar for quick mode switching, viewing webpage usage time, and accessing history

aboutStepToggleModeDesc.message:
Use Option/Alt+F or popup to switch modes (Focus: block feeds; Fun: open feeds)
Shortcut settings: chrome://extensions/shortcuts

aboutStepSetLimitsDesc.message: In the "Webpage Limits" tab, add websites you want to limit and daily usage time. Please check the blocked websites list. If the website you want to block is not on this list, please submit an issue and I will add it as soon as possible

aboutStepViewStatsDesc.message: In the "Website Statistics" tab, understand your internet habits and time distribution in real time

aboutCtaSectionDesc.message: Start using FeedSwitch now and regain control of your time!
